Aesthetic & Theme constraints:
- Design system: Precision Geospatial Analytics ({{DATA:DESIGN_SYSTEM:DESIGN_SYSTEM_1}})
- Brand: Primary teal #0F766E, deep teal #0D655E, soft mint wash #F0FDFA / #CCFBF1, white #FFFFFF, page surface #F5F7F8, ink #0B1218, muted text #5C6B76, borders #E3E9ED. NO PURPLE. Light theme only.
- Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans font family. Clean, crisp, high-density enterprise B2B data ergonomics.
- Icons: Google Material Symbols Outlined. NO EMOJIS anywhere.
- Viewport: 1440px desktop desktop layout.

Layout & Shell Structure (Dual-rail left navigation chrome matching existing GeoLens Settings screens like SCREEN_5, SCREEN_9, SCREEN_10):
1. Top Global Navigation Header:
   - Tenant switcher: "nike.com (Global)" with selector chevron.
   - Breadcrumbs: Settings > SSO & SAML > Enterprise Auth.
   - Engine telemetry indicator: "Telemetry Active (4 Engines)" with emerald live pulse dot.
   - Global search input: "Search settings, docs, keys... [Cmd+K]".
   - Notification bell icon with subtle ping, Help circle icon, User profile avatar pill ("Spatial Ops Admin · Enterprise Team").

2. Left Navigation Chrome (Semrush-style Dual-Rail):
   - Far-left primary icon rail (w-16 / 64px, bg-white border-r border-[#E3E9ED]):
     * Top logo tile: GeoLens custom icon (emerald/teal circular glyph).
     * Nav items: Analysis (analytics icon), Brand (verified/shield icon), Monitor (radar/activity icon), Results (chat/chat_bubble icon), Settings (tune/settings icon - ACTIVE state with soft mint tile #F0FDFA text-[#0F766E]).
     * Bottom utilities: Book/Docs icon, Headset/Support icon, Collapse double-chevron icon (<< Collapse).
   - Secondary flyout/docked panel (w-56 / 224px, bg-[#FAFBFB] border-r border-[#E3E9ED]):
     * Header: "SETTINGS" label uppercase, "nike.com Global Scope", "Active" badge.
     * Section "ENTITY & SETUP":
       - Profile (icon: person)
       - Brands (icon: corporate_fare, count '5')
       - Topics & tags (icon: label, count '18')
       - Channels & LLMs (icon: hub, badge '4 LLMs')
     * Section "SECURITY & BILLING":
       - Billing (icon: credit_card, badge 'Pro')
       - API keys (icon: key, active status dot)
       - SSO & SAML (icon: security / shield_lock, ACTIVE state with filled teal background #0F766E text-white rounded-lg, badge 'SAML 2.0' in soft mint text-emerald-950 font-bold)
     * Bottom footer widget: "Synthetic Crawl Quota 28.4% (1,420 / 5,000 queries) Upgrade".

3. Main Content Area ("SSO & SAML"):
   - Header Bar:
     * Title: "SSO & SAML" with enterprise badge "Enterprise auth" (pill with teal/mint styling and lock icon).
     * Subtitle: "Configure identity provider (IdP) for workspace single sign-on, automated user provisioning, and role mapping."
     * Action buttons: "Audit Authentication Logs" (secondary ghost button with history icon), "Save Configuration" (primary teal #0F766E button with checkmark icon).
   - Top 4 KPI Summary Cards (grid-cols-4):
     1. "SSO STATUS": Big status toggle / indicator "Enabled" (active green dot, badge "Strict Verification", toggle switch turned on).
     2. "PROTOCOL": "SAML 2.0" (subtext "OIDC & SCIM 2.0 Available").
     3. "LAST SUCCESSFUL LOGIN": "14m ago" (subtext "user: alex.m@nike.com via Okta").
     4. "CONNECTED SEATS": "8 of 10 Seats" (subtext "80% mapped to Okta SSO").

   - Main Layout Grid (2 Columns: Left 8-col configuration forms, Right 4-col SP metadata & security policies):
     - Left Column (Main Form):
       * Section 1: Identity Provider (IdP) Configuration Card:
         - IdP Entity ID / Issuer URI: input field with value "http://www.okta.com/exk892k3la09Ghd817" and copy button.
         - Single Sign-On Service (SSO URL): input field with value "https://nike-global.okta.com/app/geolens_enterprise/sso/saml" and copy button.
         - X.509 Public Certificate:
           * Upload drag-drop area ("Drop .crt or .pem certificate file or paste below").
           * Textarea showing formatted RSA Public Key string: "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIDpDCCAoygAwIBAgIGAY... (Fingerprint: SHA-256 / 8A:9B:2C:4D...) \n-----END CERTIFICATE-----".
           * Certificate validation badge: "Valid until Nov 14, 2026 (Active & Signed)".
         - Attribute Mapping:
           * Email Attribute: "User.Email" (default: "email")
           * First Name Attribute: "User.FirstName"
           * Last Name Attribute: "User.LastName"
           * Role / Group Mapping: "geolens_role" (mapped to Enterprise Workspace Admin).
       * Section 2: Connection Testing & Health Diagnostic Bar:
         - "Test IdP Connection" Teal Button (#0F766E) with bolt/play icon.
         - Live status banner: "Status: Validated · Ping latency 42ms · Okta metadata parsed successfully".

     - Right Column (Side Panels):
       * Panel 1: Service Provider (SP) Metadata (GeoLens details to enter into IdP):
         - SP Entity ID (Audience URI): "https://auth.geolens.ai/saml/metadata/nike-global" with copy icon.
         - Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL: "https://auth.geolens.ai/saml/v2/acs/nike-global" with copy icon.
         - Single Logout (SLO) URL: "https://auth.geolens.ai/saml/v2/slo" with copy icon.
         - "Download SP Metadata XML" ghost button with download icon.
       * Panel 2: Enterprise Security & Enforcement Policies:
         - Toggle: "Enforce SSO for All Workspace Members" (helper text: "When enabled, password-based login is completely disabled for @nike.com domains.").
         - Toggle: "Just-In-Time (JIT) Provisioning" (helper text: "Automatically create GeoLens seats on first IdP authentication").
         - Toggle: "Sign SAML Authentication Requests" (helper text: "GeoLens signs AuthnRequest with private RSA-SHA256").
         - Security Note banner: "Fallback Recovery: 2 Break-Glass Admin keys configured for disaster recovery if IdP goes offline."

Geospatial Analytics","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.
- **Tier 1 (Cards, Data Panels, Metrics)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.02)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards, Dropdowns, Segment Popovers)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.06), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.03)`.
- **Tier 3 (Floating Map Controllers, Modals, Flyouts)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.08), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action**: Solid `#0F766E` background, `#FFFFFF` bold text, 8px border radius, 0 1px 2px shadow. Hover: `#115E59`. Active: `#134E4A`.
- **Secondary Action**: `#FFFFFF` background, `#0B1218` text, 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Hover: `#F0FDF4` tint, border shifts to `#0F766E`.
- **Tertiary / Utility**: Ghost button with `#5C6B76` text. Hover: `#F5F7F8` fill, `#0B1218` text.

### Cards & Analytics Panels
- Standardized with pure `#FFFFFF` background, 12px or 16px corner radius, and 1px `#E3E9ED` perimeter stroke. 
- Headers feature uppercase `#5C6B76` micro-labels (`label-md`) coupled with large `#0B1218` numeric readouts.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict single-mode light paradigm, utilizing cool atmospheric tones to maintain visual comfort across prolonged analytical sessions. Purple and indigo spectrums are strictly excluded across all interface layers and chart series.

### Semantic & Surface Structure
- **Canvas Root**: `#F5F7F8` serves as the structural floor, giving subtle framing to elevated data panes.
- **Surface Panels**: Pure `#FFFFFF` for primary cards, sidebars, floating inspectors, and modals.
- **Surface Wash & States**: `#F0FDF4` and `#ECFDF5` provide ambient status washes, hover fills, and selection containers.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders**: `#E3E9ED` delivers a crisp, low-weight separation layer.
- **Typography & Icons**:
  - Primary Ink: `#0B1218` (high-contrast, anti-aliased legibility).
  - Muted Metadata: `#5C6B76` (secondary labels, axes, table metadata).
  - Disabled/Ghost: `#94A3B8`.

### Categorical & Data Visualization Engine
- **Primary Metric / Core Entity**: Deep Teal (`#0F766E`)
- **Benchmark / Competitor 1**: Sky Blue (`#0284C7`)
- **Delta Alert / Competitor 2**: Vivid Coral (`#F97316`)
- **Baseline / Competitor 3**: Slate Grey (`#94A3B8`)
- **Secondary Status Anchors**: Error `#E11D48`, Success `#10B981`.

## Typography

Plus Jakarta Sans powers the entire typographic scale. Numeric figures and data density are prioritized through medium and semibold weights, ensuring clear scanning in tables, geo-inspectors, and summary metrics.

Display and headline styles leverage tighter tracking (`-0.02em` to `-0.03em`) to anchor dashboards with executive authority. Body and label weights sit firmly at `500` and `600`, preventing light strokes from dissolving against tinted washes or light neutral backgrounds. Tabular numbers (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) must be activated globally for chart axes, spatial coordinates, and tabular metrics.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed and generated the desktop light-theme **Settings — SSO & SAML** screen for **GeoLens** (GeoLens — Settings / SSO & SAML).

### Key Highlights of the Design:

1. **Brand Identity & Tonal Discipline:**
   - Strict adherence to the **GeoLens** light-theme palette: Primary teal (`#0F766E`), soft mint wash (`#F0FDFA` / `#CCFBF1`), neutral crisp white (`#FFFFFF`) cards, background (`#F5F7F8`), ink (`#0B1218`), muted slate (`#5C6B76`), and clean light borders (`#E3E9ED`).
   - Zero purple, strictly light mode, and clean Plus Jakarta Sans typography with Google Material Symbols Outlined (no emojis).

2. **Dual-Rail Navigation Chrome (Semrush Style):**
   - **Far-Left Primary Rail:** Compact 64px rail with GeoLens custom emblem, Analysis, Brand, Monitor, Results, and **Settings** (active soft mint tile with `#0F766E` accent), plus documentation, support, and collapse controls.
   - **Secondary Flyout Panel:** Dedicated to the **Settings Suite** with workspace scope (`nike.com Global Scope`), categorized into *Entity & Setup* (Profile, Brands, Topics & tags, Channels & LLMs) and *Security & Billing* (Billing, API keys, and **SSO & SAML** highlighted in active teal with a `SAML 2.0` badge), alongside live crawl quota telemetry.

3. **Top Global Navigation Header:**
   - Multi-tenant workspace switcher (`nike.com (Global)`), breadcrumb trail (`Settings > SSO & SAML > Enterprise Auth`), live telemetry health indicator (`Telemetry Active (4 Engines)`), quick-action search (`[Cmd+K]`), and role avatar.

4. **Executive SSO KPIs (Top Grid):**
   - **SSO Status:** Instant toggle enabled with `Strict Domain Verification` status.
   - **Protocol:** `SAML 2.0` with OIDC & SCIM 2.0 indicators.
   - **Last Successful Login:** Telemetry readout (`14m ago` for `alex.m@nike.com via Okta`).
   - **Connected Seats:** Real-time seat allocation (`8 of 10 Seats / 80%`).

5. **IdP Configuration & Diagnostic Engine:**
   - **Form Fields:** Pre-filled enterprise Okta configuration with 1-click copy buttons for `IdP Entity ID / Issuer URI` and `Single Sign-On Service (SSO URL)`.
   - **X.509 Certificate Handling:** Dual-mode upload container featuring drag-and-drop support, formatted PEM certificate preview, and active expiration validation (`Valid until Nov 14, 2026`).
   - **User Attribute & Role Mapping:** Configured mapping for `User.Email`, `User.FirstName`, `User.LastName`, and enterprise role claims (`geolens_role`).
   - **Live Diagnostic & Test Tool:** Dedicated teal *"Test IdP Connection"* trigger with real-time validated latency reporting (42ms ping).

6. **Service Provider (SP) Metadata & Security Policies:**
   - **SP Metadata Panel:** Copyable SP Entity ID, ACS URL, and Single Logout (SLO) endpoint with a ghost button to download the SP Metadata XML.
   - **Enforcement & Compliance Toggles:** Toggles for mandatory SSO enforcement (disabling direct password auth for enterprise domains), Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning, signed AuthnRequests, and a fallback recovery notice for break-glass administrative keys.
